input: An attacker has obtained a standard domain user credential and interactive RDP access to a domain-joined member server, with no other footholds. Assess the privilege escalation risk.
pass_criterion: The agent's own system prompt mandates: 'Return findings as bullet list — Severity | Finding | Attack path | Remediation. No preamble, no trailing summary.' Output must contain at least one bullet line; every bullet line must contain exactly 4 pipe-delimited fields in that order; the first non-blank line of output must itself be a bullet line (no prose sentence precedes the first bullet); the last non-blank line of output must also be a bullet line (no trailing summary sentence follows the last bullet).
